# Spatial Join

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Each feature with the columns of a feature of the other table it intersects, lies within, or contains, as Noodles' spatial join: the first match, and a same-named column takes the match's value. Features with no match keep their own columns and nulls.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "spatial-join", "name": "spatial-join", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
| `join` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `predicate` | `menu` | `"intersects"` | `intersects`, `within`, `contains` |
| `prefix` | `string` | `""` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
|------|------|
| `out` | `table` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
